artifact.promotion_rule: Staging and production web and worker services must reference the same resolved IMAGE_DIGEST. A tag is never promotion evidence.
artifact.production_evidence_rule: A production record must embed the passed staging record SHA-256 and exactly match its sealed candidate SHA and image digest.

healthcheck.activation_requirement: Railway deployment status is SUCCESS/Active only after the configured healthcheck returns 2xx
Railway deployment status is SUCCESS/Active only after the configured healthcheck returns 2xx

predeploy.failure_rule: A nonzero migration or seed exit stops the deployment; never retry past the first unexplained failure.

database.image_selection_rule: Do not select a database image until one candidate is proven to provide PostgreSQL 16, the vector extension used by migration 0170, and Railway PITR/pgBackRest support together.
required_live_probes: select exists(select 1 from pg_available_extensions where name = 'vector')
select extversion from pg_extension where extname = 'vector'
railway postgres pitr status reports enabled with a healthy archiver and an available restore range
first pg_dump custom-format artifact exists outside the repository and has a recorded SHA-256
pg_restore --no-owner --exit-on-error succeeds against an isolated scratch database
database.evidence_order: PITR range and first dump/isolated restore are evidenced before migrate, migrate before seed, and seed before application deployment.

release_evidence.placeholder_policy: PENDING, placeholder, TODO, TBD, and unresolved deployment identities fail validation.
release_evidence.evidence_integrity: Every gate and destructive rehearsal carries a sha256 evidence digest and UTC completion time.
release_evidence.one_failure_policy: A PASSED attempt records zero unexplained failures and zero retries.
release_evidence.rollback_policy: Rollback names a distinct digest plus the known-good release-record digest, proves rollback health, restores the candidate digest, and proves candidate health.
